issue.title: Offline chapter assignment Audit
issue.body:
Audit the Offline chapter assignment against related GitHub issues and expected behavior. Test the latest supported mobile build, document results, and create `dev ready` issues for any identified gaps.

**Done when:** The assessment is merged, all gaps are linked to actionable issues, and the audit result is posted to this sub-ticket.

comments.body:
## Offline chapter assignment audit — result

**Overall:** Pass with gaps

**Assessment PR:** https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/609

**Assessment (on the branch until merge):** `docs/assessments/offline-chapter-assignment/README.md`

**Build / env:** local debug build of `main` @ `fb634e5` (dev client + Metro) against `dev.api.fluent.bible`
**Device:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), physical device; a second Android device for the two-device race (D) and the banner refresh check (G)

**Summary:** The offline part works: the first offline take claims the chapter with no prompt, the row shows "mine" and survives a relaunch, and a chapter taken by someone else shows the taken warning. The conflict UI also works when it is reached: after a translator-vs-translator race pushed within 5 minutes, the conflict indicator shows on both devices, the Record banner appears without reopening the chapter, and the conflict persists across syncs. The online claim (#268) still works. The main risk is **sync on reconnect**. Offline claims are pushed only by the full sync, so the automatic upload fails before them, the list refresh clears the provisional "mine", and with no pending uploads the only way to push a claim is signing out (Gap 2). A conflict caused by a PM assignment or an offline window longer than 5 minutes is never surfaced, and the translator's takes are stranded (Gap 1). Full master data on every Sync Now (Gap 3), a stuck upload orchestrator and duplicate upload sessions make both worse, and takes can upload to the wrong project unit when projects share a bible and book (Gap 4). Gaps 1–4 should be decided on as launch blockers. Coverage: 35 scenarios, 24 pass, 8 fail, 1 blocked (H.1), 2 skipped (F: PM conflict resolution is not implemented yet, per #271).

**Gaps:**

| Gap | Finding | Severity | Launch blocker | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Offline claim conflicts are not surfaced when a PM assigned the chapter or the offline window exceeds 5 minutes | High | To be decided with product | #610 |
| 2 | Pending offline claims are not pushed before the reconnect upload and the chapter-list refresh | High | To be decided with product | #611 |
| 3 | Full master data on every Sync Now; repeated taps get HTTP 429 (outside this audit's scope) | High | To be decided with product | #612 |
| 4 | Uploads can go to the wrong project unit when projects share bible + book (outside this audit's scope) | High | To be decided with product | #613 |

**Related findings (added to existing issues):**

| Finding | Severity | Issue |
|---|---|---|
| Upload orchestrator stuck as "server unreachable" after a 404 | — | added to #601 |
| Duplicate upload sessions and the foreground-service crash with one chapter | — | added to #599 |

Device results were also added to #271.

Will post the merged assessment link here after #609 merges.

## Offline chapter assignment audit — tests executed

These are the tests run to reach the results and gaps in this audit.

All tests were run on a physical Android device with access to Wi-Fi and mobile data.

### A. Online baseline

- **A.1** Online, open a project with fresh chapters that nobody owns. Expected: chapters unassigned, Not Started, no ownership icon.

### B. Offline claim

- **B.1** Turn on airplane mode. Expected: header cloud gray (offline).
- **B.2** Offline, open an unassigned chapter and go to Record. Expected: no taken warning; Record enabled.
- **B.3** Offline, record and stop the first take on that chapter. Expected: take saved; no claim prompt.
- **B.4** Offline, go back to View Project and My Work. Expected: the chapter shows "mine" (blue person icon) and appears in My Work.
- **B.5** Offline, record a second take on the same chapter. Expected: no change; still "mine".
- **B.6** Offline, kill and relaunch the app. Expected: chapter still "mine"; takes present.
- **B.7** Offline, check the stage label of the claimed chapter. Expected: observation only (stage label after an offline claim).
- **B.8** Offline, record on a chapter already assigned to another translator. Expected: taken warning shown; recording allowed; row stays "other".

### C. Reconnect

- **C.1** Turn Wi-Fi on and wait without tapping Sync Now. Expected: pending takes on the offline-claimed chapter upload without error.
- **C.2** Relaunch online and open Projects → the project (chapter-list refresh). Expected: the chapter still shows "mine".
- **C.3** Open Sync and tap Sync Now. Expected: the claim is pushed, takes upload, and no errors are shown.
- **C.4** On web, open the claimed chapters. Expected: assigned to the translator who recorded offline, status Draft.

### D. Conflict within 5 minutes

- **D.1** Translator A, offline, records the first take on an unassigned chapter. Expected: the chapter shows "mine" (provisional).
- **D.2** Translator B records on the same chapter online on a second device. Expected: B claims the chapter at once, with no peer checker.
- **D.3** Within 5 minutes, translator A turns Wi-Fi on and taps Sync Now. Expected: claim conflict detected; the chapter is not auto-assigned.
- **D.4** Translator A opens Projects → the project. Expected: the chapter shows the conflict indicator.
- **D.5** Translator A opens the chapter → Record. Expected: conflict banner shown.
- **D.6** Translator A taps Sync Now again. Expected: the conflict persists.
- **D.7** Translator B views the chapter on the second device. Expected: the conflict indicator is visible to B too.
- **D.8** Translator A, offline, records on another unassigned chapter; the PM assigns it to another translator on web; within 5 minutes A turns Wi-Fi on and taps Sync Now. Expected: the chapter shows the conflict indicator.

### E. Conflict after 5 minutes

- **E.1** Translator A, offline, records the first take on an unassigned chapter. Expected: the chapter shows "mine" (provisional).
- **E.5** The PM assigns the chapter to translator B on web; after at least 6 minutes, translator A turns Wi-Fi on, taps Sync Now and checks the Sync page. Expected: no claim error.
- **E.6** Translator A opens Projects → the project. Expected: the chapter shows the conflict indicator.
- **E.7** Translator A taps Sync Now again. Expected: no repeated claim error.
- **E.8** Translator A deletes the take on that chapter and syncs again. Expected: the pending claim no longer blocks sync.

### F. PM reassignment recovery

- **F-alt** With a claim stuck after E, the PM assigns the chapter to translator A on web and A runs a full sync. Expected: the claim is accepted and the claim error clears.

### G. Conflict banner refresh

- **G.1** With the Record tab open on a chapter, run a sync that sets a conflict on it, then go back to Record. Expected: the conflict banner appears without reopening the chapter.
- **G.2** Leave the chapter and open it again. Expected: the conflict banner is shown.

### H. Unassigned chapter already in Draft

- **H.1** The PM removes the assignment from a chapter already in Draft; translator A records on it offline, turns Wi-Fi on and taps Sync Now. Expected: the chapter is claimed, or a clear message is shown; no stuck claim.

### I. Online claim

- **I.1** Online, record the first take on an unassigned chapter. Expected: the chapter is claimed at once.
- **I.2** Check the chapter row after the online claim. Expected: the chapter shows "mine" at once.
- **I.3** Upload the take recorded after the online claim. Expected: the take uploads.

@Roslin22

## Offline chapter assignment — retest

> **Note:** this test script was generated with the help of AI, from the tests executed in the #533 audit (epic #526) and from other information gathered while the issues were implemented. It is a guide, not a limit: any other test that covers these points or goes beyond them is also valid.

> **Linked issues:** when a test ends with an issue number in parentheses, for example `(#611)` at the end of C.1, that is the sub-issue that fixed that point, so you can open it to see what was changed. Some of these issues are still open or depend on work that is not finished yet (for example, fluent-api changes). Those tests are marked with "issue still open" or "may fail". For them, a failure may be expected for now: report what you see, but it does not necessarily mean the fix regressed.

When someone records the first take in a chapter that belongs to nobody, the app assigns the chapter to that person. Blue person icon = yours ("mine"). "Conflict icon" = two people with a warning triangle.

**What to prepare:** two translators (A and B) in the same project, each with their own phone; a PM with access to the web app; a project with several unowned (Not Started) chapters; for I.4, two projects with the same book of the same Bible (ask the PM).

### A. Starting state (online)

- [ ] **A.1** Online, open a project with chapters that belong to nobody. Expected: Not Started chapters, no owner icon.

### B. Taking a chapter offline

- [ ] **B.1** Turn on airplane mode. Expected: the cloud icon at the top turns gray.
- [ ] **B.2** Offline, open a chapter with no owner and go to Record. Expected: no taken-chapter warning; you can record.
- [ ] **B.3** Offline, record and stop the first take of that chapter. Expected: the take is saved, with no question.
- [ ] **B.4** Offline, go back to the project list and to My Work. Expected: the chapter shows the blue person icon and appears in My Work.
- [ ] **B.5** Offline, record a second take in the same chapter. Expected: nothing changes; it is still yours.
- [ ] **B.6** Offline, close the app from recent apps and open it again. Expected: the chapter is still yours and the takes are still there.
- [ ] **B.7** Offline, look at the stage written on the chapter. Expected: just write down what is shown.
- [ ] **B.8** Offline, record in a chapter that already belongs to another translator. Expected: the taken-chapter warning appears; you can record; the chapter keeps the other-person icon.

### C. Bringing internet back

- [ ] **C.1** Turn Wi-Fi on and wait, without tapping Sync Now. Expected: the takes of the chapter you took offline upload with no error. (#611)
- [ ] **C.2** Close and open the app online, and open Projects → the project. Expected: the chapter still shows the blue person icon. (#611)
- [ ] **C.3** Open Sync and tap Sync Now. Expected: everything uploads and no error is shown. (#611)
- [ ] **C.4** On the web app, open those chapters. Expected: assigned to the translator who recorded offline, with status Draft.
- [ ] **C.5** Tap Sync Now, wait for it to finish and tap again. Then tap several times in a row. Expected: sync finishes in a few seconds (it used to take about 30); several taps in a row do not start several syncs; no error message appears. (#612)
- [ ] **C.6** After every take has uploaded, open the Sync page. Expected: the Sync Now button is still available, so you can sync even with no uploads waiting. (#611)

### D. Conflict within 5 minutes (two phones)

- [ ] **D.1** Translator A, offline, records the first take in a chapter with no owner. Expected: the chapter shows as theirs (blue icon).
- [ ] **D.2** Translator B, online on the other phone, records in the same chapter. Expected: the chapter becomes B's at once.
- [ ] **D.3** Within 5 minutes, translator A turns Wi-Fi on and taps Sync Now. Expected: the app detects the conflict and does not give the chapter to A.
- [ ] **D.4** Translator A opens Projects → the project, and also My Work. Expected: the chapter shows the conflict icon in both places.
- [ ] **D.5** Translator A opens the chapter → Record. Expected: the conflict warning appears.
- [ ] **D.6** Translator A taps Sync Now again. Expected: the conflict is still shown.
- [ ] **D.7** Translator B looks at the chapter on their phone. Expected: B also sees the conflict icon.
- [ ] **D.8** Translator A, offline, records in another chapter with no owner. The PM, on the web, assigns that chapter to another translator. Within 5 minutes, A turns Wi-Fi on and taps Sync Now. Expected: the chapter shows the conflict icon in My Work and in the project list, and the conflict warning appears on the Record tab. (#610)

### E. Conflict after 5 minutes

- [ ] **E.1** Translator A, offline, records the first take in a chapter with no owner. Expected: the chapter shows as theirs (blue icon).
- [ ] **E.5** The PM, on the web, assigns the chapter to translator B. After at least 6 minutes, translator A turns Wi-Fi on, taps Sync Now and opens the Sync page. Expected: no error is shown (nothing like "Failed to sync 1 pending chapter claim(s)"). (#610)
- [ ] **E.6** Translator A opens Projects → the project, My Work, and the chapter's Record tab. Expected: the conflict icon shows in the list and in My Work, and the conflict warning shows on the Record tab. (#610)
- [ ] **E.7** Translator A taps Sync Now again. Expected: no error is shown. (#610)
- [ ] **E.8** Translator A deletes the take in that chapter and syncs again. Expected: sync works normally, with no claim error. (#610)

### F. PM resolving the situation

- [ ] **F.1** With a chapter stuck after block E, the PM, on the web, assigns the chapter to translator A, and A taps Sync Now. Expected: the chapter goes to A and the error disappears. (conflict resolution by the PM is still being built) (#271 — issue still open)

### G. Conflict warning on the Record tab

- [ ] **G.1** With the Record tab open on a chapter, run a sync that creates a conflict on it and go back to Record. Expected: the conflict warning appears without leaving and re-entering the chapter.
- [ ] **G.2** Leave the chapter and enter it again. Expected: the conflict warning appears.

### H. Unowned chapter already in Draft

- [ ] **H.1** The PM removes the assignment from a chapter already in Draft. Translator A records in it offline, turns Wi-Fi on and taps Sync Now. Expected: the chapter goes to A, or a clear message is shown; nothing gets stuck. (not tested in the original audit)

### I. Taking a chapter online

- [ ] **I.1** Online, record the first take in a chapter with no owner. Expected: the chapter becomes yours at once.
- [ ] **I.2** Go back to the list. Expected: the chapter already shows the blue person icon.
- [ ] **I.3** Wait for the take to upload. Expected: the take uploads.
- [ ] **I.4** Use two projects with the same book of the same Bible (e.g. Ruth 3 in both). Record in the second project and sync. Expected: on the web, the audio shows in the project it was recorded in, with no upload error; in the app, the take only shows in the project it was recorded in, not in the other one. (#613)
